<script type="text/javascript">
    Sys.WebForms.PageRequestManager.getInstance().add_pageLoaded(InitQMenus);
    function InitQMenus() {
      InitQMenu("js-usermenu-button", "js-usermenu");
      InitQMenu("js-quickmenu-button", "js-quickmenu");
      document.currentmenu = undefined;
      document.currentbtn = undefined;
      OpenMyDartfishMenuIfNeeded("js-usermenu-button");
    }
    function InitQMenu(buttonId, menuId){
      var op = jQuery('#' + buttonId);
      var qm = jQuery('#' + menuId);
      op.unbind('click').bind('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();

        //closing every open menu:
        if (document.currentmenu != undefined) {
          document.currentbtn.removeClass('arrow--north');
          document.currentmenu.hide();  
        }

        // opening the menu only if this a new one:
        if (document.currentmenu != qm) {
          op.addClass('arrow--north');
          qm.show();
          document.currentmenu = qm;
          document.currentbtn = op;
        } else {
          document.currentmenu = undefined;
          document.currentbtn  = undefined;
        }

        // reisze parent for correct scrolling on mobile : to be checked with mobile.js -> InitMobileMenu -> openMenu
        if (false)
        {
          var menuMobile = jQuery('#menu-mobile');
          if (menuMobile.css('display') != 'none')
          {
            var docMaxHeight = Math.max(jQuery(window).width(), jQuery(window).height(), menuMobile.height());
            jQuery('body').css({ 'height': docMaxHeight });
          }
        }

        // external clicks:
        jQuery(document).one('click', function (e) {
          if ((qm.has(e.target).length === 0) || (jQuery(e.target).prop('target') == '_blank')) {
            op.removeClass('arrow--north');
            qm.hide();
            document.currentmenu = undefined;
            document.currentbtn = undefined;
          }
        });
        return false;
      });
    }
    function OpenMyDartfishMenuIfNeeded(menuId) {
      if  (false)
      {
          jQuery('#' + menuId).trigger('click');
      }
    }

  </script>

<script type="text/javascript">
            jQuery(document).ready(function () { InitTooltips(); });

            jQuery(window).resize(function () { InitTooltips(); });

            function InitTooltips() {
              var tooltip = jQuery('#tooltip');
              if (tooltip.length > 0) {
                var tooltiped = jQuery('.reference');
                tooltip.body = tooltip.find('.body').first();
                tooltiped.each(function (index, value) {
                  var target = jQuery(value);
                  target.infos = target.find('.infos').first();
                  if (target.infos != null && target.infos.length > 0) target.tooltipcontent = target.infos.html();

                  target.x = target.position().left;
                  target.y = target.position().top;
                  if (target.tooltipcontent) {
                    target.bind('mouseenter', function () {
                      tooltip.body.html(target.tooltipcontent);
                      tooltip.css('display', 'block');
                      tooltip.css('left', (target.x - 110) + 'px');
                      tooltip.css('top', (target.y - tooltip.height() - 15) + 'px');
                    });
                    target.bind('mouseleave', function () {
                      tooltip.css('display', 'none');
                    });
                  }
                });
              }
            }
          </script>

        var d = new Date();
        d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays*24*60*60*1000));
        var expires = "expires="+d.toUTCString();
